interpretation: Phase 1 is a structural refactor, not a measured wall-clock speedup. Comparable hot Debug runs on the same machine were 27.59s before and 27.87s after.

before.label: pre-oracle hot Debug run
before.note: TRmorph round-trips were mostly absorbed by the existing in-process cache; morphology was not the wall-clock bottleneck.

after.label: post-oracle hot Debug run
after.note: Runtime hot path uses prefilled oracle lookups; remaining flookup work happens in four stage-level prefill batches.

previousNonComparableMeasurement.reasonNotComparable: Captured under different run conditions; retained only to explain the earlier misleading baseline value.
